title: Steal Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a cyberpunk city, a street fighter loses a bout and is bound into servitude to the winner, working in an online peep room called Digital Angels, while a mysterious group called Serene moves in the background. The two summaries disagree on who serves whom (Nozomi or Coyote) (AniList, MU). Two volumes by Makoto Tateno; MU lists slavery, kidnapping, sexual assault and Stockholm syndrome.
life_message: Freedom and trust have to be wrested back from a world that buys and sells bodies.

Captivity, slavery and a dark cyberpunk underworld (AniList Slavery, Yakuza; MU).
Sex-industry peep room, voyeurism, sexual assault and attempted rape (MU Yaoi; AniList BL, Slavery).
